column3: FastAPI extracts only Pydantic type/loc values in the adapter and redacts unknown path segments at capture time because route metadata and exposure are adapter-specific; BootUI SpringBindingDiagnosticsExtractor and ExceptionStore
Unknown Pydantic custom error types become Invalid below FULL because validator-defined reason strings are untrusted; BootUI SpringBindingDiagnosticsExtractorTests
Every exposure stores only the validation error count because Pydantic's rendered exception includes input, msg, and ctx; BootUI 52ae2b63f

Non-FULL paths are redacted before storage; FULL preserves request-controlled map and unknown property names, following MessageExposure.current (MessageExposure.java:192-201) and ExceptionStore.exposeFieldPath (ExceptionStore.java:813-827), because the design permits them at FULL
Unknown exception group errors include the requested id as specified by the error contract; BootUI ExceptionStore has no equivalent error string

FastAPI validation locations retain declared query, path, header and cookie parameter names and their aliases; when no body model can be resolved, the location prefix remains and every following segment is redacted because Python route metadata supplies an explicit allowlist; BootUI SpringBindingDiagnosticsExtractor.resolveParameterName

Outside FULL, the validation exception record uses the matched FastAPI route template while the shared request context, request profile, and journal retain the raw path; FULL retains the raw exception path as BootUI does (BootUiExceptionHandlerResolver.resolveException). The non-FULL adaptation prevents rejected path values from being echoed in exception records.
